fieldNotes.location: Roster coord (34.719308,-92.326965, ROOFTOP, movedMeters 137) is accurate — lands on the PFG DC at 4901 Asher Avenue, Little Rock AR 72204. A long distribution building running NW-SE with docks on its SW face and trailer parking lots to the west and north.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View of the entrance off the access cul-de-sac clearly shows a chain-link sliding/swing gate spanning the full truck driveway, with trailers backed into docks just inside. Controlled truck entrance confirmed — truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the gate; a small structure near the gate is utility/equipment, not a multi-window booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no shack — kiosk / call-box / app check-in implied. true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank along the SW face of the long building with ~40 trailers backed in; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop rows in the lots west and north of the building; ~25-50 trailers, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate opens onto a deep paved apron / drive in front of the dock face that can hold a 3+ truck queue. drivewayLong true.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One long main DC building plus a small attached/secondary section — counted 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Little Rock's developed fabric on Asher Avenue with single-family houses immediately adjacent to the west — Urban.
